string.text: Power drain multipliers per movement state (independent, not stacked). Suit and PSU still apply their own base rates. Idle drain stays 0. Run/sprint slider floor is DOGMA default; ceiling is 2x that.
Run/sprint power drain multipliers are under D.O.G.M.A. - Gameplay - Exo Power.
